errors.text: The proposed intervention does not reconstruct the target intervention of inducing chemical short-range order and HfTi/TiZr percolative clusters.
The prediction is opposite to the target result: the target reports an approximately 12% increase in lattice thermal conductivity, whereas the hypothesis predicts a decrease.
The falsification experiment measures total thermal conductivity without separating lattice-mediated and electronic contributions, as explicitly required.

The cited evidence concerns irradiation-induced microstructural evolution in a different W-Ta-Cr-V-Hf nanocrystalline alloy and provides no evidence that irradiation reduces lattice thermal conductivity in HfNbTaTiZr.
